name: Royal Euro
oneLiner: REUR is the Royal Euro stablecoin from RIB Digital Holdings, targeting 1:1 backing with euro cash reserves held at top-tier international banks.
collateral: Euro cash reserves held through top-tier international banks to target 1:1 backing for each REUR issued by The RIB Digital Holdings Limited
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed mint and redemption route targeting 1 REUR = 1 EUR, subject to reserve sufficiency, redemption terms, and market conditions
